title: Environment
def: The Quran calls humans stewards (khalīfa) of the earth, forbids waste and corruption, and sets a balance (mīzān).
what: “Eat and drink, but do not be wasteful; He does not love the wasteful” (7:31, 6:141). “Do not cause corruption on the earth after it has been set right” (7:56). “He raised the heaven and set up the balance, so do not transgress the balance” (55:7–8). The Prophet said that if the Hour is about to come and one of you has a sapling in his hand, he should plant it (Ahmad), and that any Muslim who plants a tree or sows a crop from which a bird, person or animal eats has given charity (Sahih al-Bukhari).

title: Ethics and conduct
def: The Quran’s teaching on character, justice, honesty and kindness in everyday life.
what: “God commands justice and good conduct, and giving to relatives, and forbids indecency and wrongdoing and oppression” (16:90). “Be just; it is closer to piety” (5:8). “Do not follow what you have no knowledge of” (17:36). “Avoid much suspicion” (49:12). The Quran tells the Prophet: “you are of great character” (68:4). He said that he was sent to perfect good character (Ahmad).
